documents.thermal.md:
# Thermal interlock

The pump requires a ceramic filter.

A thermal interlock means a switch that stops the motor when the housing overheats.
documents.water.md:
# Water circuit

The filter depends on a bypass valve.

A filter means a mesh screen.
documents.pressure.md:
# Pressure calibration

Differential pressure (DP) means the difference between upstream and downstream pressure.

Zero the transmitter at 0 kPa.
documents.electrical.md:
# Electrical isolation

The motor requires a regulator.

Disconnect the battery before servicing terminals.
